pr_title: [BUG][CI]Fix qwen3next nightly ci && add tp size constraint in faq for Qwen3Next

rule.description: 当添加硬件或模型相关的约束检查时，错误消息应明确说明不支持的具体场景、原因以及已知的底层问题，便于用户定位和解决问题。

antipattern.code:
from vllm.config import ModelConfig, ParallelConfig, VllmConfig

class NPUPlatform(Platform):
    # ... 其他方法 ...

    @classmethod
    def check_and_update_config(cls, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
        """检查并更新 vLLM 配置，包含 NPU 平台特定的约束检查"""
        model_config = vllm_config.model_config
        parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
        # ... 其他配置检查逻辑 ...

        # 检查 head size 与 TP 的兼容性
        # ❌ 未限定模型类型，对所有模型都生效；且缺少 model_config 空值保护
        if model_config.get_num_attention_heads(parallel_config) == \
                model_config.get_num_kv_heads(parallel_config):
            if model_config.get_head_size() not in [64, 128, 192]:
                raise ValueError("Not supported")

from vllm.config import ModelConfig, ParallelConfig, VllmConfig

class NPUPlatform(Platform):
    # ... 其他方法 ...

    @classmethod
    def check_and_update_config(cls, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
        """检查并更新 vLLM 配置，包含 NPU 平台特定的约束检查"""
        model_config = vllm_config.model_config
        parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
        # ... 其他配置检查逻辑 ...

        # ✅ 添加 model_config 空值保护和 model_type 判断，仅对 qwen 模型生效
        if model_config is not None and model_config.model_type == "qwen":
            if model_config.get_num_attention_heads(
                    vllm_config.parallel_config) == \
                    model_config.get_num_kv_heads(
                        vllm_config.parallel_config) \
                    and model_config.get_head_size() not in [64, 128, 192]:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Models with head dim out of [64, 128, 192] "
                    "do not support tp >= 16 now. "
                    "There is a known issue on "
                    "torch_npu.npu_fused_infer_attention_score "
                    "on this scenario.")
